div.h1: Odoo POS System for Retail, Restaurants & Textile in Egypt
div.p: Complete Point of Sale deployment — software, hardware, training, and support. Works offline, syncs across stores, prints receipts, scans barcodes. From single-store to multi-branch chains.

مين بيستخدم Odoo POS؟
Every business has different POS needs. Here's how Odoo POS adapts to yours.
Barcode scanning, weight-based products, loyalty cards, daily cash reconciliation. Multi-cashier with shift management. Integration with inventory for automatic reorder.
Floor plans, table management, kitchen display (KDS), split bills, tips. Kitchen printing for food orders. Ingredient tracking through inventory. Takeaway and dine-in modes.
Our specialty. POS Cutting Orders module manages fabric cutting directly from POS — dimensions, quantities, fabric type. Real-time stock tracking per roll. Manager PIN for discounts.
Expiry date tracking, lot/serial numbers, prescription management, insurance integration. Barcode scanning for medications. Daily sales reports for regulatory compliance.
Size and color variants, RFID tagging, customer profiles with purchase history, loyalty programs. Multi-location stock visibility. Season-based pricing and promotions.
Centralized management for unlimited locations. Per-store pricelists, warehouses, payment methods. Real-time inventory sync. Consolidated reporting and analytics.
مميزات النظام
Internet drops? No problem. POS continues working. All orders sync automatically when connection returns. Zero lost sales.
Every sale updates stock instantly across all locations. Our POS Stock Real-Time module adds reactive badges showing current quantities on product cards.
USB HID barcode scanners work plug-and-play. Scan products, customer cards, coupons. Generate and print barcodes for your products.
Our POS Security Framework: manager PIN for refunds and discounts, discount limits per user, session locking. Backend validation prevents frontend bypasses.
Cash, card, bank transfer, mobile payments. Split payments across methods. Customer accounts with credit limits. Partial payments with balance tracking.
Points-based loyalty programs, automatic discounts, buy-X-get-Y promotions, coupon codes, gift cards. All configurable from backend.
ESC/POS thermal printers (Epson, Star). Custom receipt layout with logo, Arabic text, QR codes. Kitchen printing for restaurants. IoT Box or direct network printing.
Runs on any device with a browser: iPad, Android tablet, laptop, desktop, touchscreen monitor. No special hardware required. Responsive UI.
Daily sales summary, per-product analysis, cashier performance, payment method breakdown. Export to Excel. Integrated with Odoo's full BI engine.
🛒 Published on Odoo Apps Store
Built from real client needs. Published on the official Odoo Apps Store.
Manage fabric cutting directly from POS. Track dimensions, quantities, fabric type. Dedicated cutting screen with dark/light mode. Manager PIN for approvals.
Live inventory badges on product cards. Batch loading for large catalogs. Navbar refresh button. Reactive updates via custom events. Zero lag on 10K+ products.
Manager PIN for session close, refunds, and critical ops. Discount limit enforcement at 3 levels. Role-based access. Backend validation layer.
الأجهزة المطلوبة
We handle complete hardware procurement, configuration, and installation.
Epson TM-T20III or Star TSP143 — ESC/POS thermal printer. USB or network (Ethernet/Wi-Fi). Supports Arabic text, logos, QR codes. Connected via Odoo IoT Box or direct network.
USB HID scanner — plug and play, no drivers needed. Reads 1D and 2D barcodes. Wireless Bluetooth options available. Works instantly with Odoo POS.
RJ11 cash drawer — connects to receipt printer. Opens automatically on cash payment. Manual key override. Standard 5-bill 8-coin tray.
LCD/LED display — shows order items and total to customer. Connected via IoT Box or secondary screen. Supports Arabic and English.
Any device with a browser — iPad, Android tablet, touchscreen PC, laptop. No special hardware required. We recommend 10"+ screen for comfortable use.
Odoo IoT Box — connects printers, scanners, scales, and displays. Required for some printer models. Alternative: direct USB/network printing without IoT Box.

Multi-store deployment. Custom UI/receipts. Barcode setup. Loyalty program. Inventory integration. Hardware procurement. 6 months support.

Everything in Business + custom module development (cutting orders, security, special workflows). Full ERP integration. 12 months support. Dedicated account manager.
🏆 Real Deployment
A textile trading company needed POS with fabric cutting management. Here's what we built.
Al-Ghazl Al-Arabi sells fabric by the meter. Cashiers needed to create cutting orders (fabric type, dimensions, quantity) directly from the POS screen. Standard Odoo POS doesn't support this.

We built POS Cutting Orders (ma_pos_cutting) — a custom module that adds a cutting order workflow to the POS. Dedicated cutting screen, real-time tracking, manager PIN for approvals, dark/light mode. Now published on Odoo Apps Store.
Multi-session POS across 2 locations. Real-time stock sync between stores. Manager security controls. Cutting orders processed 3x faster than paper-based system. Zero stock discrepancies.

div.h3: How much does Odoo POS cost in Egypt?
div.p: Odoo Community POS is free. Enterprise requires licensing. Our implementation packages start from basic single-store setup. Custom modules on Odoo Apps Store start at €99. Contact us for a detailed quote based on your needs.

div.h3: Does Odoo POS work without internet?
div.p: Yes. Odoo POS is a Progressive Web App that continues working when internet drops. All transactions sync automatically when connection returns. We configure offline mode as part of every deployment.

div.h3: What printers work with Odoo POS?
div.p: ESC/POS thermal printers: Epson TM-T20III, Star TSP143, and compatible models. Connected via Odoo IoT Box (USB/Bluetooth) or direct network printing (Ethernet/Wi-Fi). We handle printer procurement and setup.

div.h3: Can I use Odoo POS for a restaurant?
div.p: Yes. Built-in floor plans, table management, kitchen display (KDS), split bills, tips. Kitchen printing sends food orders directly to the kitchen printer. Full integration with inventory for ingredient tracking.

div.h3: How long does POS setup take?
div.p: Single store: 3-5 days. Multi-store: 1-2 weeks. With custom modules: 2-4 weeks. Includes product import, hardware setup, receipt configuration, staff training, and testing.

div.h3: Do you serve areas outside Aswan?
div.p: Yes. Software setup is done remotely. For hardware installation, we travel to your location. We serve all of Egypt, with focus on Upper Egypt (Aswan, Luxor, Qena, Sohag).
